# ASP.NET Core

- ASP-006: Handle uploaded files safely: never use a client-supplied file name for saving a file to physical storage; when the app stores uploads on physical storage, never grant execute permission on the storage location; set a maximum size limit to prevent large uploads; do not persist uploaded files in the same directory tree as the app; and the uploaded file's extension should be checked against a list of permitted extensions. BLZ-022 adds the Blazor file-upload page's own advice.
